title: Regularisation of Status of Certain Residents of Namibia, their Descendants and Foreign Spouses Act, 2024
in_force: not yet in force (per Laws.Africa, collection checked 30 October 2026)
site_status: IN INCOMING (laws-2026-11-21.csv row 61): add dates and commencement status
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Laws.Africa PDF supplied by IMR. Assented to 2 October 2024; published in Government Gazette 8549 on 30 December 2024. s. 8: comes into operation on a date set by the Minister by Gazette notice (different dates possible for different provisions); not commenced as at 30 October 2026. Lets long-term residents holding South West Africa identification documents apply for citizenship by naturalisation within 5 years of commencement (s. 2, extendable by up to 2 years), with routes for their descendants (s. 3) and foreign spouses (s. 4). title: Refugees Act, 2017
source_tier: Official (National Assembly of Zambia, Act as printed by the Government Printer)
site_status: NEW: add to national-laws; replaces the historic Refugees (Control) Act, 1970 row
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the National Assembly PDF supplied by IMR. Assented to 12 April 2017; date at head of Act 13 April 2017. Domesticates the 1951 Convention, 1967 Protocol and 1969 OAU Convention; establishes the Commissioner for Refugees, a Refugee Status Determination Committee and the Refugees Fund. s. 41: a recognised refugee may be issued a work or study permit under the Immigration and Deportation Act, 2010 and is then treated like other foreign nationals; s. 42: right to self-employment in agriculture, industry, handicrafts and commerce. Repeals the Refugees (Control) Act, 1970 (Cap. 120). Also on ZambiaLII (not checked).

title: Non-Citizens (Employment Regulation) Regulations, 2016
source_tier: LII (TanzLII); signed copy also on the Labour Commissioner's site kazi.go.tz (official agency copy)
site_status: IN INCOMING (laws-2026-11-21.csv row 19): signing date, agency copy, content note
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the signed scan on kazi.go.tz supplied by IMR: https://www.kazi.go.tz/uploads/documents/en-1599782575-Regulation%20Non%20Citizen.pdf%20FINAL.pdf (GN number and publication date left blank in that copy; GN 331 of 2016 and Gazette date 30 Dec 2016 from TanzLII). Made under Act 1 of 2015 and signed in Dar es Salaam on 21 December 2016 by the Minister of State (Labour, Youth, Employment and Persons with Disability). Mainland Tanzania only. Work permit decision within 14 days (reg. 5); labour market test (reg. 6(1)(d)); regional free-movement and bilateral agreements to be considered (reg. 6(2)); refugee applications go through the Director of Refugees (reg. 7); bulk recruitment at 10 locals per non-citizen (reg. 9); succession plan with a Tanzanian understudy (reg. 16); employer must repatriate the worker to the place of recruitment when the contract ends (reg. 23); appeal to the Minister within 30 days (reg. 21).
